answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond and climbs three dawn summits, filing a quill-signed log at each. A raven courier carries each log to the thread ledger, so no farm files a thousand. Auditors replay the thread; a skipped summit or reused log burns the bond and bans the key. First milestone 40, k-th 40+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,537,500 plus 70,000 bonded against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file three milestones for 40 and keep the bond.
